summary: Innovate BC's stacked logo from the cover of its 2024/2025 Impact Report: the wordmark and the white i as the PDF's own vector paths, over the report's star-trail photograph clipped to its circle, kept as the logo's texture.

alsoChecked.title: 2022–2023 Impact Report
alsoChecked.finding: The logo is an embedded image on the cover (536 × 429) and on the back cover (747 × 598, white on orange); no vector paths.

assets.label: Innovate BC — Full colour, 2024/2025 Impact Report
assets.dateNote: The report's year, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: The disc with the white i, over “innovate BC” with “BC” in teal. The wordmark and the i are the report's own vector paths; the disc is the report's star-trail photograph, kept as the logo's texture and clipped to the report's own circle.
assets.fidelityNote: The wordmark, the i and the disc's circle are the PDF's own paths and colours, extracted with PyMuPDF 1.26.6 (research/identity/innovate-bc-vector-2026-11-12/extract.py). The disc's photograph (252 × 252) is the report's own, converted from CMYK to RGB by MuPDF and embedded as a JPEG at quality 92, placed where the cover places it.
